newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha reluctantly dragged up by crude, swaps.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha reluctantly dragged up by crude, swaps.

text.p: NWE naphtha rose sharply on Thursday but traders said the impetus was stronger crude and swaps and not its own fundamentals.
End-user demand remained lacklustre and supplies were available, including at least two Algerian cargoes this month and smaller Russian parcels to become available at the end of the month, they said.
Bidding interest surfaced for pipeline spec material for delivery by Nov 25, traders said, but the buyer did not appear willing to close any deals.
